doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: Picking up saxophone and gigging around St. Louis after the show
summary: He could play saxophone at once, then gigged in St. Louis, with Jelly Roll briefly, and went to Harrisburg, Illinois for gangsters.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Yeah. No, I figured that out myself. What was it, tennis? No, Aldo. Aldo.

The first time I picked up a saxophone, I could play it. Oh yeah? Yeah. But, also singing is quite different. From a clarinet? Yeah. Well, all, all saxophones, things are the same for that matter. But, uh, it's different from a clarinet. Still in all, if you can play a clarinet, you can play a saxophone. Something real easy, because the clarinet is a lot more difficult instrument than a saxophone. But I had, uh, and I had food with a saxophone before, a little bit, you know, because my teacher was a saxophone player. This man, a lot. And, uh, anyway, when, when, when I, when I left the medicine show, like I said, I stayed around St. Louis there, worked with Satan those guys for a while, and I worked with Jelly Roll for a couple of weeks, he came through there. Where? In St. Louis? Yeah. And around St. Louis, gigging around, doing different deals, you know, different jobs. Whatever saxophone player you had, I don't know, a guy had got sick, this guy, uh, I can't remember many of the guys in the band, I think it's Joe Poston, or whatever guy's name.
Joe Poston? Yeah. Just playing with Jimmy New York? He was playing saxophone. Yeah? Yeah.

And Zooty, Zooty had been around St. Louis just before then. It was really in Chicago last time. Well, Zooty had been playing in St. Louis though, I hadn't been playing with those guys, but they was talking about him. Then I played around there for a long, uh, not, well, not too long. Then I went to, uh, Harrisburg, Illinois with, with a bunch of guys and started working for these gangsters, Charlie Berger and his gang.
